title: Father and Daughter, 1950s Vintage B&W Snapshot Photo
description: Vintage 1950s black and white square snapshot depicting a father holding his 16-month-old daughter ('Sandy') on his lap while sitting on a outdoor patio. The man is wearing a short-sleeved plaid collared shirt and wide-leg trousers, while the toddler sits cheerfully in a patterned dress and white baby shoes. The backdrop features mid-century concrete block walling. Hand-annotated on the front margins in blue ink: 'Sandy & Daddy' across the top margin and '16 mo - Prof. Sterling' across the bottom.
